name: radar-chart
title: Radar Chart
description: A radar chart whose shapes grow from the centre and morph to new values; tap the legend to compare.

perf.budget: The web is built once per size. Each series is one path rebuilt from a handful of points on the UI thread while it grows or morphs, then static.

a11y.reducedMotion: Shapes appear at their values; new values replace the old without morphing.
a11y.screenReader: The chart reads as an image listing every series by axis; legend chips are switches.
a11y.touchTarget: Legend chips are at least 44 pt tall.
